scope: Requirements only; full reference, fault, task and publication gates are separate. No Native or model executed.
origin: Numbered source contact roles are drawn from bound CAD/XML. Numeric bench loads, stimuli, limits and ideal external devices are explicit curator choices, not author measurements or guarantees.
numbering: Exact numbered CAD pads, not connector cable colours or guessed mirrored mating view.
design_acceptance: Functional equivalence to the public requirements; no exact internal topology, netname, CAD UUID, coordinate or reference-file equality grading.
schematic_task_scope: Schematic tasks do not acquire PCB or manufacturing delivery requirements from the private full-board reference standard.
reference_proof_dependency: Select exact models and actual assertion implementation and bind final CAD/dependencies at reference proof. Missing executable alone is not a requirements blocker.
part_identity: The source populated Value is LFCN-490+. The inherited LFCN-160/160MHz symbol metadata/datasheet is not valid 490+ primary documentation. An equivalent qualified implementation may meet the same board-port requirements.

fixture.ports: Single-ended50ohm source and50ohm load referenced at the external numbered J1/J2 coaxial signal and shell terminals; input available power -10dBm.
fixture.frequency: Board-port small signal sweep100MHz to1.5GHz. Continuous100..400MHz passband and exact1GHz stopband predicate; a chosen interpolation/grid/extremum error bound must substantiate the continuous band at reference proof.
fixture.parasitics: Include actual final board launches/interconnect/ground and selected part nonideality. Standalone chip S2P alone does not prove assembled board-port performance.

acceptance.predicate: Insertion loss -20log10|S21| at the declared50ohm external board reference planes is <=1dB throughout100..400MHz and >=20dB at1GHz.

All declared ground contacts mutually <=1ohm atDC; no accidental zero-ohm copper/wire short from either RF signal terminal to ground. Selected filter internal network is evaluated using its qualified model, not treated as a wire.

outside_scope: Other transceiver circuitry in the same repository
Ideal brick-wall filter as a substitute for selected-part behavior
